## 1. Visual Theme & Atmosphere

Al News is a Spotify-inspired content platform for AI/tech news. The interface lives in a near-black depth range, borrowing Spotify's strongest visual traits: immersive darkness, compact scan-friendly density, restrained accent usage, rounded tactile controls, and content-first hierarchy.

Unlike a music player, the primary content is article metadata, summaries, tags, author identity, and discussion threads. The atmosphere is professional and tech-focused, dense but readable in Korean, modern and dark by default with light theme compatibility maintained through semantic tokens.

The design system is expressed through Phlex components, RubyUI primitives, and Tailwind v4 utilities. All styling flows through CSS custom properties — never hardcoded palette classes.

**Key Characteristics:**
- Background base: `oklch(0.145 0 0)` (dark) / `oklch(1 0 0)` (light)
- Primary font: `Noto Sans KR`, sans-serif
- Brand accent: `oklch(0.7205 0.192 149.49)` (green, hue ~150)
- Border style: `oklch(1 0 0 / 10%)` (dark) / `oklch(0.922 0 0)` (light)

### Background Surfaces
- **Surface Default** (bg-app): `oklch(0.145 0 0)` dark / `oklch(1 0 0)` light
- **Surface Subtle** (bg-surface): `oklch(0.205 0 0)` dark / `oklch(0.97 0 0)` light
- **Surface Muted** (bg-surface-muted): `oklch(0.269 0 0)` dark / neutral-200 light
- **Surface Elevated** (bg-surface-elevated): `oklch(0.205 0 0)` dark / white light

### Text & Content
- **Primary Text** (text-content): `oklch(0.985 0 0)` dark / `oklch(0.145 0 0)` light
- **Secondary Text** (text-content-secondary): neutral-200 dark / neutral-800 light
- **Muted Text** (text-content-muted): `oklch(0.708 0 0)` dark / `oklch(0.556 0 0)` light
- **Disabled Text** (text-content-disabled): neutral-600 dark / neutral-400 light
- **Brand Text** (text-accent-text): brand-primary-light dark / brand-primary-dark light

### Brand & Interactive
- **Interactive Primary** (--primary): `oklch(0.7205 0.192 149.49)`
- **Interactive Primary Foreground**: `oklch(0.985 0 0)`
- **Destructive** (--destructive): `oklch(0.704 0.191 22.216)` dark / `oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)` light

### Status Semantics
- **Danger Solid**: `oklch(0.577 0.215 27)` / hover: `oklch(0.505 0.191 28)`
- **Danger Text**: `oklch(0.711 0.166 22)` dark / danger-solid light
- **Info Solid**: `oklch(0.546 0.215 263)` / hover: `oklch(0.488 0.217 264)`
- **Info Text**: `oklch(0.714 0.143 255)` dark / info-solid light

### Color Distribution (60:30:10 법칙)

시각적 조화를 위해 모든 화면/컴포지션에서 색상 비율을 다음과 같이 유지한다:

- **60% — 지배 색상 (Dominant)**: 배경 surface 계열 (`bg-app`, `bg-surface`, `bg-surface-muted`). 프레임의 가장 넓은 면적을 차지하며 전반적인 톤을 결정한다.
- **30% — 보조 색상 (Secondary)**: 텍스트, 카드 구분선, neutral 계열 (`text-content`, `text-content-secondary`, `border-border-*`). 콘텐츠 구조와 위계를 형성한다.
- **10% — 포인트 색상 (Accent)**: 브랜드/상태 색상 (`bg-brand-solid`, `text-accent-text`, status colors). CTA, 활성 상태, 핵심 지표에만 제한적으로 사용해 시선을 유도한다.

이 비율을 깨뜨리는 대표적 안티패턴: 카드 배경에 brand 색을 채우기, 본문 텍스트에 accent 색 남용, 여러 status 색을 동시에 동일 영역에 노출.

### Borders & Dividers
- **Border Strong** (border-border-strong): neutral-700 dark / neutral-300 light
- **Border Muted** (border-border-muted): neutral-600 dark / neutral-400 light
- **Border Subtle** (border-border-subtle): neutral-800 dark / neutral-200 light
- **Focus Ring** (ring-brand): `oklch(0.7205 0.192 149.49)`

### Shadows
- **SM**: `0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05)` (migrate to oklch)
- **MD**: `0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)`
- **LG**: `0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)`
- **XL**: `0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)`
- **Focus Green**: `0 0 0 3px rgb(var(--brand-primary) / 0.5)`

## 3. Typography Rules

### Font Family
- **Primary**: `Noto Sans KR`, fallback: `sans-serif`
- **Prose accent**: `sky-300` (dark) / `sky-800` (light) for strong emphasis

### Hierarchy

| Role | Size | Weight | Line Height | Token |
|------|------|--------|-------------|-------|
| Page title | 30–36px | 700 | 1.25 (tight) | `text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold` |
| Section heading | 18px | 600 | 1.375 (snug) | `text-lg font-semibold` |
| Body large | 16px | 400 | 1.625 (relaxed) | `text-base leading-relaxed` |
| Body | 14px | 400 | 1.5 (normal) | `text-sm` |
| Meta / small | 14px | 500 | 1.5 | `text-sm font-medium` |
| Fine print | 12px | 400 | 1.4 | `text-xs` |

### Typography Principles
- Bold headings and regular body copy as the primary contrast system
- Compact and functional sizes optimized for scan speed
- Slightly more breathing room than Spotify for Korean readability
- Stronger tracking and firmer weight for system actions
- Avoid excessive uppercase for Korean labels

## 4. Component Stylings

### Component Priority
1. RubyUI component (24 categories available)
2. Phlex composition around RubyUI
3. Custom markup only when no suitable RubyUI component exists

### Buttons

**Primary** — `bg-brand-solid hover:bg-brand-solid-hover text-brand-foreground`
- Padding: `px-4 py-2`
- Font: `text-sm font-medium`
- Radius: `rounded-lg` (8px)
- Transition: `transition-colors`

**Secondary** — `bg-surface-muted hover:bg-surface text-content-secondary`
- Same padding/font/radius as primary

**Danger** — `bg-surface-muted hover:bg-danger-solid text-content-secondary hover:text-danger-text`

**Info** — `bg-info-solid hover:bg-info-solid-hover text-brand-foreground`

### Cards

**Standard (RubyUI::Card)**
```ruby
class: "bg-surface shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-shadow overflow-hidden border border-border-strong p-3 md:p-6"
```

**Transparent / Profile**
```ruby
class: "bg-app/40 border border-border-subtle rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl"
```

### Inputs (RubyUI::Input)
```ruby
class: "bg-surface-muted border-border-muted text-content placeholder:text-content-muted"
```

### Select / Dropdown
- Use `RubyUI::DropdownMenu` for action groups
- Use `RubyUI::Popover` for lightweight contextual UI
- Surface: `bg-surface-elevated`

### Switch & Checkbox
- `RubyUI::Switch` for single boolean preferences
- `RubyUI::Checkbox` for multi-select, consent, bulk actions

### Navigation
```ruby
nav(class: "bg-surface border-b border-border-strong border-t-4 border-t-brand")
```

### Avatar (RubyUI::Avatar)
```ruby
class: "h-24 w-24 ring-4 ring-app bg-app shadow-xl"
# Fallback: bg-brand-solid text-brand-foreground font-bold
```

### Badge (RubyUI::Badge)
| Variant | Example |
|---------|---------|
| green | "Following" |
| amber | "Requesting" |
| default | neutral state |

### Radius Mapping (radiusTone: rounded)

| Component | Radius | Value |
|-----------|--------|-------|
| Button | `rounded-lg` | 8px |
| Input | `rounded-md` | 8px |
| Card | `rounded-lg` | 12px |
| Dialog/Modal | `rounded-lg` | 12px |
| Badge/Pill | `rounded-full` | 9999px |
| Profile card | `rounded-2xl` | 24px |

## 5. Layout Principles

### Spacing System
- Base unit: `8px` rhythm
- Scale: 4px (xs), 8px (sm), 16px (md), 24px (lg), 32px (xl), 48px (2xl), 64px (3xl), 96px (4xl)

### Container & Grid
- Dense grids on desktop
- Simplified stacking on tablet
- Single-column reading and action flow on mobile
- No decorative complexity that harms content retrieval

### Whitespace Philosophy
Dense, scan-friendly layout that balances Korean readability with Spotify's compact information density. Space is functional, not decorative — tight metadata blocks, standard card padding, loosened reading areas.

---

## 6. Depth & Elevation

Dark interfaces need visible separation. Priority order:

1. **Surface contrast first** — shade differences between bg-app, bg-surface, bg-surface-muted
2. **Border subtlety second** — border-border-strong, border-border-subtle
3. **Shadow third** — only for overlays and floating UI

| Level | Use Case |
|-------|----------|
| Flat | Page background, table rows |
| SM | Cards, inputs |
| MD | Dropdowns, popovers |
| LG | Modals, dialogs |
| XL | Spotlight dialogs, profile cards |
| Focus | Keyboard focus ring (`ring-brand ring-offset-app`) |

---

## 7. Do's and Don'ts

### Do
- Start from a near-black canvas and build depth through shade differences
- Prefer semantic tokens (`bg-surface`, `text-content`) over raw palette classes
- Keep information dense enough for fast scanning
- Use accent color functionally, not decoratively
- Favor rounded controls and soft panels
- Use Phlex and RubyUI as the primary expression layer
- Maintain Korean-friendly typography and spacing
- Preserve dark/light compatibility through token mapping
- Use `box-shadow` for interactive borders (no layout shift)
- Verify APCA Lc >= 60 for all text/surface pairs

### Don't
- Don't hardcode Tailwind palette colors like `bg-slate-800` or `text-white`
- Don't add decorative accent colors outside the token system
- Don't introduce ERB for new UI work when Phlex is the project standard
- Don't bypass RubyUI if an equivalent component already exists
- Don't make the layout airy like a marketing site; this is a content product
- Don't rely on color alone to communicate state
- Don't use primitive tokens in components (only semantic tokens)

---

## 8. Responsive Behavior

### Breakpoints
| Name | Width | Key Changes |
|------|-------|-------------|
| Mobile | < 640px | Single column, stacked layouts |
| Tablet | 640–1024px | Two-column, condensed nav |
| Desktop | > 1024px | Full layout, expanded nav, dense grids |

### Touch Targets
- Minimum tap target: `44x44px`
- Buttons maintain comfortable size on mobile

### Collapsing Strategy
- Article cards and metadata must remain scannable
- Navigation simplifies cleanly on smaller screens
- Reading views preserve line length and hierarchy
- Touch targets remain comfortable on mobile

---

## 9. Accessibility Baseline

### Required
- Keyboard navigable controls
- Visible focus styles: `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-app`
- Skip link support ("Skip to main content")
- ARIA labels on meaningful navigation and toggles
- Reduced motion support (`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`)
- APCA Lc >= 60 for body text, Lc >= 75 for small text
- WCAG 2.x 4.5:1 alongside APCA for legal compliance

### Contrast Validation Pairs
- `text-content` on `bg-app` (primary text on page background)
- `text-content-secondary` on `bg-app`
- `text-content-muted` on `bg-app`
- `text-accent-text` on `bg-app`

---

## 11. Token Architecture

### Source of Truth Files
- `app/assets/tailwind/tokens.css` — Tier 1 primitives + Tier 2 semantic theme mappings
- `app/assets/tailwind/application.css` — RubyUI semantic layer (OKLCH) + Tailwind v4 @theme
- `app/assets/tailwind/site.css` — Layout and page-specific styles
- `app/assets/tailwind/pagy-tailwind.css` — Pagination styles

### Token Tiers
1. **Primitive** — raw OKLCH values (brand, neutral, status)
2. **Semantic** — theme-aware purpose tokens (`.theme-dark`, `.theme-light`)
3. **Component** — Tailwind utility aliases (bg-app, bg-surface, text-content)

### Theme Switching
- Attribute: CSS class (`.theme-dark`, `.theme-light`)
- Tailwind: `@custom-variant dark (&:is(.theme-dark *, .dark *));`
- Provider: Custom Stimulus controller (localStorage + matchMedia + data attribute)

## 12. Decisions Log

- `2026-04-10` — Design Farmer initial analysis. Maturity: MATURE (8/10). Existing 3-tier token architecture preserved.
- `2026-04-10` — Discovery: pain points (visual inconsistency + DX), vision (internal consistency), colors (keep existing + OKLCH normalize), radius (rounded 8px), scope (core interactive), theming (light+dark via Stimulus), a11y (AA+APCA), platforms (web+mobile hybrid).
- `2026-04-10` — Architecture: preserve existing directory structure, no JS build pipeline, Tailwind v4 native token system.
- `2026-04-10` — Theme: class-based switching preserved (.theme-dark/.theme-light), Stimulus controller contract defined.
- `2026-09-22` — Contrast review (`docs/design-system-review-2026-09-22.md`). RubyUI `--primary`/`--destructive` now alias the solid tokens (`--semantic-brand-solid`, `--semantic-danger-solid`) with white foreground; they are background-only. Text uses `text-link` / `text-danger-text`, never `text-primary` / `text-destructive`. `--color-brand` is theme-aware via `--semantic-brand` (green-700 in light) so `ring-brand` meets 3:1.
- `2026-09-22` — RubyUI surface tokens now alias app tokens (single source in `tokens.css`): `--background` → `bg-app`, `--card`/`--popover` → `bg-surface-elevated`, `--muted`/`--secondary` → `bg-surface-muted`, `--accent` → `bg-surface-hover`, `--border` → `--semantic-border`. Floating UI uses `bg-popover`, cards `bg-card`. Reference borders via `--semantic-border`, not `--color-border` (collides with Tailwind's theme namespace).

## 13. Agent Prompt Guide

### Quick Token Reference
- Primary action background: `bg-brand-solid`
- Page background: `bg-app`
- Card background: `bg-surface`
- Primary text: `text-content`
- Secondary text: `text-content-secondary`
- Muted text: `text-content-muted`
- Border default: `border-border-strong`
- Error state: `text-danger-text` / `bg-danger-solid`
- Info state: `text-info-text` / `bg-info-solid`
- Focus ring: `ring-brand ring-offset-app`

### Example Component Prompts
- "Create a card: `bg-surface` bg, `border-border-strong` outline, `rounded-lg`, padding `p-3 md:p-6`"
- "Create a primary button: `bg-brand-solid` bg, `text-brand-foreground` text, hover `bg-brand-solid-hover`"
- "Create an input: `bg-surface-muted` bg, `border-border-muted`, `text-content`, placeholder `text-content-muted`"

### Iteration Guide
1. Always reference semantic tokens, never raw Tailwind palette colors
2. Check RubyUI first before building custom components
3. Test hover/focus/active/disabled states in both light and dark themes
4. Verify APCA Lc >= 60 for any new text/background pair
5. Use Phlex for all new view work (no ERB)
